outcome: Spontaneous preterm birth (sPTB) in a subsequent pregnancy
cohort: 821 nulliparous women with two consecutive singleton deliveries between 2014 and 2017 at a tertiary center
finding: A prolonged second stage of labor in the index pregnancy was not associated with an increased risk of subsequent sPTB, while a second stage cesarean section may be associated with an increased risk, but this did not reach statistical significance.
mod_finding: A second stage cesarean section in the index pregnancy may be associated with an increased risk of subsequent sPTB, however there was no statistically significant difference.
